domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbYeYDjwmf7geACxC5Z

18.3.0 pre-cut re-check, wave 5, card **W5-EXPORT**: a targeted check of the whole-deployment export and its re-install (#28914 / PR #29755, #29342 / PR #29746, ADR-0146 D8 item 3). Sweep anchor: #27377. Wave-4 comparison: none (new surface, no ledger item covers it).

## Environment fingerprint

- Framework: `objectstack-ai/objectstack` `main` @ `589049b023d82c94508bf9fce752ea19069279e5`, checked out detached (`ui/` the same commit; no console build: every leg is api/cli).
- Subject CI: push run 41600797636 re-read at 08:58Z: `completed` / `success`.
- Build: `pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2` under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, exit 0, 21m32s (08:27:34Z to 08:49:06Z); `check-dev-prereqs` green (106 artifacts).
- Boots, each from its own scratch copy of `examples/app-showcase` (node_modules symlinked), own `OS_HOME`, upload root and file DB: `OS_PORT=P node packages/cli/bin/run.js dev --ui --seed-admin --no-watch -p P -d file:RUN/data.db`
  - source: port 41510, booted 08:49Z;
  - target 1 (re-install by `os package install`): port 41520, fresh DB;
  - target 2 (re-install by `POST /marketplace/install-local`, plus probes): port 41530, fresh DB.
- Personas: seeded admin `admin@objectos.ai`; a member minted by `POST /auth/admin/create-user` (+ `change-password`), holding neither `studio.access` nor `setup.access`; anonymous.
- install-local ledgers landed in each scratch copy's `.objectstack/installed-packages/`; the tree's `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/` does not exist after the run.
- Run executed sequentially by one runner (no subagents: one targeted check, one ontology).

## Scope

Selector `release-18.3.0-w5-export`: one targeted check, no ledger item (so no `revision` to pin). Surfaces: `GET /api/v1/packages/export`, `client.packages.exportAll()`, `os package export [--out DIR]`, `withheldMaps` per entry, `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` naming incomplete maps, ADR-0146 D8 (a pair's export is `GET /packages/X.custom/export`).

Ontology built on the source boot:

| package | how | content |
|---|---|---|
| `com.qa.w5export` | `POST /packages` (source `authored`), ns `w5export` | object `w5export_item` (title, amount), flow `w5export_probe`, connector `w5export_erp` with `providerConfig.headers` `{X-W5-Tenant: …}`; all drafted with `?package=` and published (`publish-drafts` 3 published / 0 failed) |
| `com.example.showcase.custom` | `POST /packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization` (201, ns `showcase_custom`) | `object_extension` `showcase_task` adding `w5_region__c`, published |
| `com.qa.w5local` | `POST /marketplace/install-local` (source `marketplace`) | object `w5local_thing`, flow `w5local_probe` |
| `com.qa.w5off` | `POST /packages`, `dependencies: {com.qa.w5export: ^0.1.0}` | object `w5off_note`, published, then `PATCH /packages/com.qa.w5off/disable` (200, `enabled: false`) |

## Per-clause verdicts

| # | clause | verdict | evidence (text oracle) |
|---|---|---|---|
| E1 | as admin, `GET /packages/export` answers every non-`code` package once, the disabled one included, code-registered excluded | pass | 200; order `com.qa.w5export, com.example.showcase.custom, com.qa.w5local, com.qa.w5off`; `GET /packages` holds 33 rows, exactly those 4 are not `source: code`; no id repeated; `com.example.showcase` and the 28 platform packages absent |
| E2 | dependencies first; a pair after its base | pass | `com.qa.w5off` (depends on `com.qa.w5export`) after it. The pair's base `com.example.showcase` is `code`, so the pair is exported alone, as ADR-0146 D8 item 3 (PR #29830 wording) and the bundle docblock say ("A pair of a `code` base is still exported") |
| E3 | each entry byte-equal to `GET /packages/:id/export` | pass | `JSON.stringify` of each bundle entry equals the per-package `data` for all 4 |
| E4 | `withheldMaps` names the connector's map, and no header name or value travels | pass | `com.qa.w5export.withheldMaps = [{type: connector, name: w5export_erp, path: providerConfig.headers}]`; connector exported as `providerConfig: {baseUrl}`; the bundle text contains neither `X-W5-Tenant` nor its value; no other entry carries the key |
| E5 | the disabled package's entry carries its content | **fail** | `com.qa.w5off` entry is `{id, name, version, namespace, dependencies}` with no `objects`, while its `sys_metadata` row `object/w5off_note` is `active`. Re-enable: the entry carries `objects: [w5off_note]`; disable again: empty again. See repro R1 |
| E6 | any query parameter is refused 400 VALIDATION_ERROR naming it | pass | `?foo=1`, `?package=…`, `?version=1` each 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `The "foo" query parameter is not supported by this endpoint…` (each names its own parameter) |
| E7 | a member without `studio.access`/`setup.access` → 403; anonymous → 401 | pass | member 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` "Reading packages requires the `studio.access` or `setup.access` capability." (per-package export the same); anonymous 401 `UNAUTHENTICATED`; admin 200 (control) |
| E8 | `client.packages.exportAll()` answers the bundle | pass | built `@objectstack/client` dist, admin token: same 4 ids, `JSON.stringify` equal to the REST `data`; an anonymous client throws `httpStatus 401`, `code UNAUTHENTICATED` |
| E9 | `os package export --out DIR`: one numbered directory per package, in dependency order | pass | exit 0, `01-com.qa.w5export … 04-com.qa.w5off`, each `objectstack.json` equal to bundle entry N; the same `--out` again refused exit 1 "already holds files" |
| E10 | fresh boot: installing each directory in order lands objects, fields, flows and the pair's extension, served | pass | target 1, `os package install DIR/NN/objectstack.json` ×4, all exit 0: `w5export_item` meta 200 + `POST /data` 201 + list 200; flows `w5export_probe`, `w5local_probe` 200; connector 200 (`providerConfig: {baseUrl}`); `showcase_task` serves `w5_region__c` "W5 Region"; `w5local_thing` 200. (`w5off_note` 404: it was never in the export, E5) |
| E11 | the install answer names each withheld map as incomplete, and logs a warn | pass | target 2, `POST /marketplace/install-local {manifest: entry}`: `com.qa.w5export` answers 200 with `withheldMaps: [{connector, w5export_erp, providerConfig.headers}]`, the other three none; boot log `WARN [MarketplaceInstallLocal] installed com.qa.w5export managed with 1 connector map(s) the package export withheld whole, each now absent: connector 'w5export_erp' providerConfig.headers…` (target 1 logged the same line). The CLI's own output names nothing: see the probe line |
| E12 | re-reading `GET /packages/export` on the new boot matches the first, modulo withheld values | **fail** | target 1: same 4 ids in the same order; `com.qa.w5local` and `com.qa.w5off` byte-equal; `com.qa.w5export` differs only by `withheldMaps` (expected: the map is absent on the target); **`com.example.showcase.custom` lost `objectExtensions`** although the target still serves `w5_region__c` and `GET /packages/com.example.showcase/customizations` still lists it. See repro R2 |

## Reproduction rules

**R1 (E5): a disabled package exports as an empty shell.** Fresh showcase boot, admin bearer token.
1. `POST /api/v1/packages {"manifest":{"id":"com.qa.w5off","name":"W5 disabled","version":"0.1.0","type":"app","namespace":"w5off"}}` → 201.
2. `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/w5off_note?mode=draft&package=com.qa.w5off {"name":"w5off_note","label":"W5 Note","sharingModel":"private","fields":{"body":{"type":"text","label":"Body"}}}` → 200; `POST /api/v1/packages/com.qa.w5off/publish-drafts {}` → 200 `published` 1.
3. `GET /api/v1/packages/com.qa.w5off/export` → 200 with `objects: [w5off_note]` (control).
4. `PATCH /api/v1/packages/com.qa.w5off/disable` → 200 `enabled: false`.
5. `GET /api/v1/packages/com.qa.w5off/export` and `GET /api/v1/packages/export`.
- Expected: the entry still carries `objects: [w5off_note]` (the bundle declaration: "Enabled or not, every such package is exported … an install of the bundle installs every entry enabled").
- Actual: 200 `{"id":"com.qa.w5off","name":"W5 disabled","version":"0.1.0","namespace":"w5off"}`, no `objects`; the `sys_metadata` row stays `state: active`. Re-enable → content back. Reproduced three times on the source boot. Installing that entry elsewhere installs an empty package, so the object is lost from the deployment copy with no error.

**R2 (E12): an export omits the `objectExtensions` of a package installed through install-local.** Fresh showcase boot, admin bearer token.
1. `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local {"manifest":{"id":"com.qa.r2base","namespace":"r2base","name":"r2 base","version":"1.0.0","type":"app","objects":[{"name":"r2base_account","label":"Account","sharingModel":"private","fields":{"title":{"type":"text","label":"Title"}}}]}}` → 200.
2. `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local {"manifest":{"id":"com.qa.r2ext","namespace":"r2ext","name":"r2 ext","version":"1.0.0","type":"app","dependencies":{"com.qa.r2base":"^1"},"objectExtensions":[{"extend":"r2base_account","fields":{"r2ext_code":{"type":"text","label":"Billing code"}}}]}}` → 200.
3. `GET /api/v1/meta/object/r2base_account` → `fields.r2ext_code.label` = "Billing code" (the extension is served).
4. `GET /api/v1/packages/com.qa.r2ext/export`.
- Expected: the entry carries `objectExtensions: [{extend: r2base_account, fields: {r2ext_code: …}}]`, as the export of a pair whose `object_extension` was authored does (the source pair's export carried `objectExtensions: [showcase_task + w5_region__c]`).
- Actual: 200 `{"id":"com.qa.r2ext","name":"r2 ext","version":"1.0.0","namespace":"r2ext","dependencies":{"com.qa.r2base":"^1"}}`, no `objectExtensions`. Reproduced on target 2 (this shape), and on the source boot and target 1 with a second package extending `w5local_thing`. In the round trip: the source pair `com.example.showcase.custom` exported its extension; installed on target 1 by `os package install`, it serves `w5_region__c`, but its re-export has no `objectExtensions`, so a second export → install hop drops the customization with no error.

## Derived verdict

Targeted check: **fail** (E5, E12 fail; E1–E4, E6–E11 pass).

## Off-clause probes (RUNNER rule 8)

About 12 minutes, admin and member personas, on the source and target 2 boots. Boundary classes: missing dependency, out-of-order install, malformed input, failure inside assembly, the CLI install path.
- Ordering with a missing dependency: `POST /packages` declaring a dependency on a not-yet-created package → 422 `DEPENDENCY_MISSING`, nothing installed; installing the dependent export entry (`04-com.qa.w5off`) before its dependency through install-local → 422 `DEPENDENCY_MISSING` naming `com.qa.w5export ^0.1.0`; installing in the served order then succeeds. Holds.
- Malformed `withheldMaps` (`path: providerConfig.secret`) on install-local → 400 `PLUGIN_MANIFEST_INVALID` naming the allowed positions. Holds.
- A package whose assembly throws → whole bundle refused: not reached live. Deleting the stored connector row of a published authored package under a running boot left the served read 200 (registry-held), so the export did not throw. The branch is pinned only at the dispatcher-over-stub layer: `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-export-bundle.test.ts` 10/10 passed at the subject (incl. both whole-or-absent cases), `packages/cli/test/package-export.test.ts` 6/6. The per-type silent skip inside assembly is #29760 (fix PR #29824 open).
- **Found:** `os package install DIR/NN/objectstack.json`, the command `os package export` prints for each directory, says nothing about an incomplete connector map: for `01-com.qa.w5export` it printed "Package installed into the running kernel" and the cache path, while the install-local answer it received carried `withheldMaps` (seen on target 2 through the same door). Extracted, see the close-out.
